style.styleTitle: Homcom 5ft Artificial Christmas Tree with 513 Tips
style.toneOfVoice: Tired of sparse, artificial-looking holiday trees that wobble and drop messy needles? The HOMCOM 5ft artificial Christmas tree transforms your seasonal setup into a luxurious experience. Featuring 513 main branch tips, its realistic PE foliage offers a soft, authentic touch and lush fullness without the clean-up. Anchored by a fir wood base for balance and rustic style, this flame-retardant tree automatically opens via hinges—giving active homes a safe and timeless festive centerpiece. . The Xmas tree features a 5ft full-bodied holiday profile, creating an impressive centerpiece for living rooms, offices and foyers; . Engineered with 513 main branch tips and each with 13-tip clusters for extreme density; . The PE foliage provides a real-touch softness and authentic forest realism; . Hinged tips drop automatically, making shaping quicker than normal trees; . Sectional trunks make storage compact once festivities end; . Flame-retardant PE and PVC foliage slow fire spread for family-first holiday safety; . A robust fir wood base (F50 x 22H cm) delivers stability and a unique, elevated wood aesthetic; . Colour: Green; . Material: PE, PVC, Steel, Fir Wood; . Overall Dimensions: F96 x 150H cm; . Base Dimensions: F50 x 22H cm; . Branch Tip Count: 513; . Item Label: 83C-297V00GN; . Shaping Note: Approx. 30-50 minutes of manual branch tips shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
